label: judgment
explanation: The title 'Specialist Solutions Architect' is a pre-sales technical advisory role and does not match Priya's target roles of AI Engineer/ML Engineer or Data Engineer. Independently disqualifying: the description explicitly requires '6+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role,' which exceeds the 3-year experience cap. Relevant skills (Python, SQL, Databricks, AWS) appear in both the description and Priya's résumé, but skill overlap cannot overcome the role-type mismatch and the experience-years hard cap.
